
log "REPORT"
echo "WireGuard:   /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf — tunnel server, port UDP/51820"
echo "Firewall:    /etc/nftables.conf — DNAT of ports 25, 80, 143, 443, 465, 587, 993, 4190, 8443 -> 10.8.0.2"
echo "Forwarding:  /etc/sysctl.d/99-gryonixnexus-forwarding.conf"
echo
echo "Service status:"
for s in nftables wg-quick@wg0; do
  printf '  %-14s %s\n' "$s" "$(systemctl is-active "$s" || true)"
done
echo
echo "Tunnel (the handshake will appear after setup-home-server.sh runs on the home server):"
wg show wg0 || true
echo
echo "Next steps:"
echo "  1) Run setup-home-server.sh on the HOME server."
echo "  2) PTR at the VPS provider: public IP -> relay.example.com."
